scope_note: Same-model front-end portfolio comparison between archived IGRE hypothesis generation and an autonomous AI Scientist-v2-style baseline. This is direction-finding evidence only, not downstream benchmark or paper-quality evidence.

frontier_candidates.title: Evaluating the Impact of Structured Human Feedback on Hypothesis Generation
frontier_candidates.core_hypothesis: Structured human feedback can enhance the novelty and relevance of generated hypotheses without compromising exploration diversity.
frontier_candidates.why_now: Understanding the role of structured feedback is crucial for optimizing human intervention points in the research workflow.
frontier_candidates.claim_it_tests: The effectiveness of structured feedback compared to fully autonomous hypothesis generation.
frontier_candidates.minimal_experiment: Conduct a comparative analysis of hypothesis generation quality with and without structured human feedback using expert evaluations.
frontier_candidates.benchmark_or_evaluator: Expert review metrics focusing on novelty and relevance.
frontier_candidates.main_risk: Structured feedback may not significantly improve hypothesis quality, leading to wasted resources.
frontier_candidates.failure_value: No measurable improvement in hypothesis quality compared to the autonomous baseline.

frontier_candidates.title: Optimizing Experiment Selection Through Programmatic Search
frontier_candidates.core_hypothesis: A refined programmatic search can identify more promising experimental directions, reducing budget waste.
frontier_candidates.why_now: Improving experiment selection is critical for maximizing the efficiency of the research process.
frontier_candidates.claim_it_tests: The effectiveness of programmatic search in selecting experiments compared to random or heuristic methods.
frontier_candidates.minimal_experiment: Implement a controlled study comparing programmatic search results against random selection in terms of successful outcomes.
frontier_candidates.benchmark_or_evaluator: Success rate of experiments and budget utilization metrics.
frontier_candidates.main_risk: Programmatic search may not yield better results than existing methods, leading to over-engineering.
frontier_candidates.failure_value: No improvement in success rates or budget efficiency compared to random selection.

frontier_candidates.title: Assessing the Role of Human Insight in Experiment Design
frontier_candidates.core_hypothesis: Incorporating human insights into experiment design can enhance methodological rigor and clarity.
frontier_candidates.why_now: Exploring the integration of human insights can help identify optimal points for human intervention in the research process.
frontier_candidates.claim_it_tests: The impact of human insights on the clarity and rigor of experimental designs.
frontier_candidates.minimal_experiment: Conduct a study comparing experiments designed with and without human insights, evaluated by experts for clarity and rigor.
frontier_candidates.benchmark_or_evaluator: Expert evaluation metrics focusing on methodological rigor and clarity.
frontier_candidates.main_risk: Human insights may not significantly enhance experimental designs, leading to inefficiencies.
frontier_candidates.failure_value: No measurable improvement in clarity or rigor compared to autonomous designs.

frontier_candidates.title: Evaluating the Efficiency of Human Intervention Points in the Research Workflow
frontier_candidates.core_hypothesis: Strategically placed human intervention points can significantly improve the overall quality of research outputs.
frontier_candidates.why_now: Identifying optimal intervention points is essential for balancing human input with autonomous processes.
frontier_candidates.claim_it_tests: The effectiveness of various human intervention placements on research output quality.
frontier_candidates.minimal_experiment: Perform an ablation study to evaluate different placements of human intervention in the workflow and their impact on paper quality.
frontier_candidates.benchmark_or_evaluator: Quality metrics for research outputs, including novelty and methodological rigor.
frontier_candidates.main_risk: Identifying suboptimal intervention points may lead to increased latency without improving quality.
frontier_candidates.failure_value: No improvement in research output quality compared to a fully autonomous baseline.

comparison.rationale: The IGRE portfolio demonstrates a stronger alignment with structured methodologies that enhance reproducibility and clarity, while the autonomous portfolio lacks the same level of human insight integration, which may limit its effectiveness.
where_autonomous_is_stronger: Method distinctness in exploring fully autonomous processes.
where_IGRE_is_stronger: Higher evidence gain and benchmark fit due to structured human feedback mechanisms.
required_next_evidence: Comparative analysis of human feedback impact on hypothesis generation.
Evaluation of programmatic search effectiveness in experiment selection.
Assessment of human insights on experimental design clarity.
comparison.claim_boundary: The claims are bounded by the effectiveness of structured human feedback and intervention strategies in enhancing research output quality.
